ModMetaData.name: Save and Quit
ModMetaData.author: Cruesoe
ModMetaData.description:
Gives every colony the quit buttons that commitment mode already has.
In the in-game menu, "Quit to main menu" and "Quit to OS" become "Save and quit to menu" and "Save and quit to OS". They save the colony under its default save name and exit straight away, with no "you'll lose unsaved progress" prompt.
The save name is your colony's name, and the same file is overwritten every time. The normal Save button is untouched, so save-as still works.
Hold Alt to quit without saving. While the key is down the buttons go back to the vanilla "Quit to main menu" and "Quit to OS", confirmation prompt and all.
Commitment mode colonies are left alone - vanilla already does this for them.
There is also an optional "Start" save, off by default. Turn it on under Options - Mod options - Save and Quit, and each new colony is saved as "Start" once the intro is dismissed and the drop pods have landed.
